versions.guide:
Kill the sentry

A sentry guards the fortress gate. Eliminate him carefully, or he will raise the alarm.

Open the gate

The others are waiting for the gate to open so they can storm the fortress.

Break into the prison

Several more guards are inside the fortress, so you will have to fight your way through. A lever opens the prison entrance.

Escape

The guards seem to have received reinforcements. It is time to get out!

The Captive

Fairuz's fiancée Alia was caught stealing and is being held in the small fortress in the Necromancers' Desert. She will soon be moved to the main prison, which is much more heavily guarded. Fairuz asks his friends to help rescue her before that happens. This will be a dangerous undertaking...
